title: Concept: Account opening date in a response
description: The date the relationship started in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The date is a common knowledge-based verification answer, and it also tells an attacker how long a dormant account has been unattended.
applicability: Deployments that render the date the relationship started into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The date is a common knowledge-based verification answer, and it also tells an attacker how long a dormant account has been unattended.
